The '''Luxury Cruiser 200''' was a [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. This model was popular among the young rich of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Small enough to be intimate and cozy, the 200 was built for amusement, not combat.
